title: Most news feeds are designed to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
body:
It is easy to feel like you are drowning in information while starving for actual insight. We have all been there. You open an app, scroll through a dozen headlines, and five minutes later you realize you have not really learned anything new. The problem is that most news algorithms prioritize engagement over understanding. They show you what is loud, not what is relevant to your life.

True personalization should be the opposite of an echo chamber. It should not just feed you more of what you already think. Instead, it should help you connect the dots on the topics that actually matter to you, in a way that respects your time. You should be able to dig deep into complex stories without having to sift through the noise.

We built Headlinne because we believe technology can make us smarter, not just distracted. By using AI to curate and clarify the news, we aim to give you back control over your attention. It is about getting the full picture, quickly, so you can spend your energy on the things that actually require your focus.
cta: If you want a news experience that values your intelligence, take a look at HEADLINNE.com.
